mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM erp_product WHERE deleted = 0 AND registration_expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND registration_expiry_date BETWEEN #{now} AND #{future}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM erp_supplier WHERE deleted = 0 AND license_expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND license_expiry_date < #{now}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM erp_customer WHERE deleted = 0 AND credit_limit > 0 AND (current_debt / credit_limit) >= 0.8

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM erp_sale_order o INNER JOIN erp_sale_order_items i ON o.id = i.order_id AND i.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN erp_product p ON i.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND p.is_restricted = 1 AND o.create_time >= #{startOfMonth}

SELECT p.id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.standard AS standard, u.name AS unitName, s.batch_no AS batchNo, s.production_date AS productionDate, s.expiry_date AS expiryDate, s.count AS closingStock, p.is_restricted AS isRestricted FROM erp_stock s INNER JOIN erp_product p ON s.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN erp_product_unit u ON u.id = p.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.count > 0 AND s.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND s.expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY s.expiry_date ASC
SELECT SUM(s.count * p.sale_price) FROM erp_stock s INNER JOIN erp_product p ON s.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0
SELECT SUM(current_debt) FROM erp_customer WHERE deleted = 0

(SELECT 1 AS type, r.no AS no, c.name AS businessName, r.total_price AS amount, a.name AS accountName, r.receipt_time AS time FROM erp_finance_receipt r LEFT JOIN erp_customer c ON r.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN erp_account a ON r.account_id = a.id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 20 AND r.receipt_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS type, p.no AS no, s.name AS businessName, p.total_price AS amount, a.name AS accountName, p.payment_time AS time FROM erp_finance_payment p LEFT JOIN erp_supplier s ON p.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN erp_account a ON p.account_id = a.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 20 AND p.payment_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) ORDER BY time DESC

SELECT c.name AS customerName, SUM(i.count) AS count, SUM(i.total_price) AS totalPrice FROM erp_sale_order o INNER JOIN erp_sale_order_items i ON o.id = i.order_id AND i.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN erp_product p ON i.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN erp_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 20 AND p.is_restricted = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT id, name, contact, mobile, business_license_no AS businessLicenseNo, license_expiry_date AS licenseExpiryDate FROM erp_supplier WHERE deleted = 0 AND license_expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND license_expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) ORDER BY license_expiry_date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(total_price), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(id) AS count FROM erp_sale_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 20 AND order_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(order_time) ORDER BY DATE(order_time) ASC

SELECT p.name AS productName, p.is_restricted AS isRestricted, u.name AS unitName, /* 采购汇总 */ IFNULL(agg.totalInCount, 0) AS totalInCount, agg.productionDate AS productionDate, agg.expiryDate AS expiryDate, /* 最早一次采购 */ first_in.order_time AS firstInTime, first_in.no AS firstInNo, first_in.supplierName AS supplierName, /* 仓储 */ w.name AS warehouseName, IFNULL(stock.count, 0) AS currentStock FROM erp_product p LEFT JOIN erp_product_unit u ON u.id = p.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 /* 采购明细汇总 */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT poi.product_id, poi.batch_no, SUM(poi.count) AS totalInCount, MAX(poi.production_date) AS productionDate, MAX(poi.expiry_date) AS expiryDate FROM erp_purchase_order_items poi INNER JOIN erp_purchase_order po ON po.id = poi.order_id AND po.deleted = 0 WHERE poi.deleted = 0 AND poi.product_id = #{productId} AND (#{batchNo} IS NULL OR #{batchNo} = '' OR poi.batch_no = #{batchNo}) GROUP BY poi.product_id, poi.batch_no ) agg ON agg.product_id = p.id /* 最早一次采购订单（供应商、入库单号） */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT po2.order_time, po2.no, s.name AS supplierName FROM erp_purchase_order po2 INNER JOIN erp_purchase_order_items poi2 ON poi2.order_id = po2.id AND poi2.deleted = 0 AND poi2.product_id = #{productId} AND (#{batchNo} IS NULL OR #{batchNo} = '' OR poi2.batch_no = #{batchNo}) LEFT JOIN erp_supplier s ON s.id = po2.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE po2.deleted = 0 ORDER BY po2.order_time ASC LIMIT 1 ) first_in ON 1 = 1 /* 当前库存（取第一条批次库存记录） */ LEFT JOIN erp_stock stock ON stock.product_id = p.id AND stock.deleted = 0 AND (#{batchNo} IS NULL OR #{batchNo} = '' OR stock.batch_no = #{batchNo}) LEFT JOIN erp_warehouse w ON w.id = stock.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.id = #{productId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS salesCount, IFNULL(SUM(i.count), 0) AS totalOutCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.name ORDER BY c.name SEPARATOR '、') AS mainCustomerNames, MAX(CASE WHEN o.camera_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hasVideoInt FROM erp_sale_order o INNER JOIN erp_sale_order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.product_id = #{productId} AND (#{batchNo} = '' OR i.batch_no = #{batchNo}) LEFT JOIN erp_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0
